summary: Gulf County clippings from 1942 to 1998 place a fire tower at White City, also called St. Joe; a 1973 staffer and 1998 buildings are noted. No build or current-condition source.

events.note: One of four aircraft spotting stations in Gulf County was located at the fire tower at White City.
A Florida Department of Forestry employee who lived and worked at the tower died in a highway crash about four miles west of Wewahitchka.
Burglars broke into the shop area of the facility on the tower grounds and took tools and electronic equipment valued at about $10,000.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Clippings call the tower the St. Joe fire tower (1947, 1949) and the White City fire tower (1942, 1973, 1998). Treated as one tower because the 1947 clipping places the St. Joe tower near White City; no source says so outright.

notes_for_editor: Clippings from a hobby site; originals not checked. Consider other_names for 'St. Joe fire tower' once a source confirms it; a search result also gave 'Saint Joe Firetower' (not read).
